final: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), cross_avg AS (SELECT AVG(amount) AS overall_avg FROM trans), above_avg_regions AS (SELECT rs.region, rs.avg_amount, rs.transaction_count, rs.avg_amount - ca.overall_avg AS difference_above FROM region_stats rs CROSS JOIN cross_avg ca WHERE rs.avg_amount > ca.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS avg_of_avg_amounts, AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_transaction_count, AVG(difference_above) AS avg_difference_above FROM above_avg_regions
